description:
Structured diff showing what would be deployed if the user ran tfdeploy now.
Returns component-level changes (added/removed/modified), field-level details, and pricing deltas.

Defaults (#1392): with no version arguments, compares the LAST SUCCESSFULLY DEPLOYED version against the user's CURRENT LIVE DESIGN (the same data the UI shows). Empty baseline if nothing has been deployed or after a destroy. Pending drafts are NOT used as the target — they go stale once the user edits past them; live IR via chat history is always current.

Pass explicit `from_version` and/or `to_version` integers to compare any two saved versions (e.g. v3 → v5).

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).

from_version.description: Starting stack version number for the diff. Defaults to the latest applied version.

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

to_version.description: Ending stack version number for the diff. Defaults to the current draft.

name: stackdiff

components.description: Changed components, each with key, change and per-field from/to values.

from_version.description: Version number the diff starts from.

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

pricing_delta.description: Monthly cost before and after (from_total, to_total).

to_version.description: Version number the diff ends at.

title: Compare Stack Versions
